plot: On Friday at midnight, the night before Mia's birthday, a box with air holes and a bow scratches, squeaks and sneezes; Zeek guesses a robot vacuum and then a raccoon while Crispy is amazed it isn't scared of him, the bros barely stop the rocking box from falling off the table, and Bup links the red rubber bone, the bow and the red strap on the chair — a leash — so it is Mia's birthday puppy, who licks Crispy and then starts crying loudly in the sleeping house.

script.title: Who Is Scratching Inside the Box With Holes

beats.say: Who is scratching inside that box? It just moved by itself!
Stay back, Zeek. A box with holes is a box that breathes.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Dad left the box on the table, whispered shh, and went upstairs.
On a chair hangs a red strap. Nobody looks at it.
Holes mean breathing. Breathing means alive. Alive means NOPE!
Easy. Dad isn't scary. Whatever is in there, Dad chose it.
And it has a bow on top. Scary things don't get bows.
I'll identify it scientifically. Crispy, I need a light.
My eyes glow. I am the light.
Something tumbles out of a hole. A small red rubber bone.
It squeaked! The box squeaked at us!
Theory one. A robot vacuum. They bump, beep and squeak.
A robot vacuum for Mia's birthday? That's a terrible present.
Robots don't breathe. Listen.
Soft breathing. A tiny snort. Then one small sneeze.
Theory two. A raccoon. Dad caught a raccoon in the backyard.
A raccoon?! Raccoons eat everything! We ARE everything!
If it's a raccoon, this table is a buffet. We're dessert.
Nobody puts a bow on a raccoon, Bup.
Wait. A cup against the box. Old trick. You hear everything.
Zeek holds a teacup to the box. Pim leans on Zeek.
A heartbeat. Fast. Tiny. Like a scared little drum.
That's my heartbeat. Sorry. I'm leaning on you.
A little heart, stuck alone in a dark box. Poor thing.
Then I'll look through a hole myself.
Crispy leans close. Two shiny black eyes stare right back at him.
It's looking at me. And it isn't scared of me.
Everyone's scared of you at first, Crispy. Even we were.
It's sniffing you. Your burnt toast smell. Fascinating.
It's tasting you with its nose! Crispy, back away slowly!
The box rocks harder. It slides toward the edge of the table.
If that box falls, the whole house wakes up!
Everybody push! Back to the middle! Now!
Five tiny bros push one big box. It moves one crumb.
The box stops, half over the edge. Everybody breathes again.
Wait. A red rubber bone. A bow. Air holes. And this.
That red strap Dad hung on the chair. That's a leash.
A leash? Then the thing inside the box is...
A tiny wet nose pushes out through the biggest hole.
A puppy! It's Mia's birthday puppy!
Dad planned this for months. And we nearly pushed it off.
A puppy? Are puppies nice? Are they nice to beans?
The puppy licks Crispy. A big, slow, happy lick.
It licked me. Nobody has ever... licked me before.
Puppies love warm things. Crispy is basically a pocket heater.
Mia draws puppies everywhere. On the fridge. On her shoes. Everywhere.
Okay. It stays secret till the birthday morning. Not one peep.
Hear that, puppy? Not a peep. Not a woof. Please.
The puppy yawns. Then it starts to cry. Loudly.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Ep 3 · Who Is Scratching Inside the Box With Holes? 📦
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"Everybody's scared of me at first. This thing wasn't." — Crispy
Dad leaves a box with air holes on the dinner table at midnight, and it scratches, squeaks and sneezes. Robot vacuum? Raccoon? The Dough Bros have to find out before it falls.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: Ep 3 · ¿Quién rasca dentro de la caja con agujeros? 📦
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasará en la próxima parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Todos me tienen miedo al principio. Esa cosa no." — Crispy
A medianoche papá deja en la mesa una caja con agujeros, y rasca, chilla y estornuda. ¿Una aspiradora robot? ¿Un mapache? Los Dough Bros deben descubrirlo antes de que se caiga.
#serie #animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Ep 3 · Quem está arranhando dentro da caixa com furos? 📦
pt.description:
O que você acha que vai acontecer na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Todo mundo tem medo de mim no começo. Aquilo não teve." — Crispy
À meia-noite o papai deixa na mesa uma caixa com furinhos, e ela arranha, guincha e espirra. Robô aspirador? Guaxinim? Os Dough Bros precisam descobrir antes que ela caia.
#série #animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: Ep 3 · من يخربش داخل الصندوق المثقوب؟ 📦
ar.description:
ما رأيك، ماذا سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"الجميع يخافون مني في البداية. أما هذا فلم يخف." — كريسبي
عند منتصف الليل يترك الأب صندوقًا مثقوبًا على طاولة العشاء، فيخربش ويصفر ويعطس. مكنسة روبوت؟ راكون؟ على الدو بروز أن يكتشفوا قبل أن يسقط.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Ep 3 · Qui gratte dans la boîte percée de trous ? 📦
fr.description:
À votre avis, que va-t-il se passer dans la prochaine partie ? Dites-le-moi en commentaire.
« Tout le monde a peur de moi au début. Pas cette chose. » — Crispy
À minuit, papa laisse sur la table une boîte percée de trous, et elle gratte, couine et éternue. Un aspirateur robot ? Un raton laveur ? Les Dough Bros doivent savoir avant qu'elle tombe.
#série #animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: Ep 3 · 穴のあいた箱の中でカリカリしてるのは誰？📦
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起こると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「みんな最初はぼくをこわがる。でも、こいつはちがった。」— クリスピー
真夜中、パパが食卓に置いていった穴あきの箱。カリカリ、キュッ、クシュン。ロボット掃除機？アライグマ？落ちる前に正体をつかめ。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: Ep 3 · 구멍 뚫린 상자 안에서 긁는 건 누구야? 📦
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날 것 같아? 댓글로 알려 줘.
"다들 처음엔 날 무서워해. 그런데 얘는 아니었어." — 크리스피
한밤중 아빠가 식탁에 두고 간 구멍 뚫린 상자가 긁고, 삑삑대고, 재채기한다. 로봇청소기? 너구리? 상자가 떨어지기 전에 알아내야 한다.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Ep 3 · Wer kratzt da in der Kiste mit den Löchern? 📦
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
„Am Anfang haben alle Angst vor mir. Das Ding nicht.“ — Crispy
Um Mitternacht stellt Papa eine Kiste mit Luftlöchern auf den Esstisch, und sie kratzt, quietscht und niest. Saugroboter? Waschbär? Die Dough Bros müssen es herausfinden, bevor sie herunterfällt.
#serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
